messages:
Maria: Observed 500ms P95 for dedicated-pool us-west2-rack-7 starting ~06:12 UTC. Network egress on that rack spiked, looks correlated with tenant 'sprint-ml'.
Aj: Saw the same in telemetry. toR tx drops jumped at the same time. Suspect egress/noisy neighbor rather than GPU OOMs.
Kevin: Is that the rack where we flipped ephemeral handoff + prefetch for fractional slices last week?
Maria: Yes. Fractional-slices + prefetch might be warming lots of KVCaches -> NVLink bursts. Also noticed ~10k small flows to a single external S3 domain.
Devon: Can we apply per-tenant egress throttling at the rack level? Current egress-shaper lives in hyperplane and doesn't do slot-level limits.
Aj: We have an egress policer prototype in lab. Config example (rough):
```
tc qdisc add dev eth0 root handle 1: htb default 10
tc class add dev eth0 parent 1: classid 1:10 htb rate 50mbit
# attach u32 filters mapping tenant-id -> class
```
But it needs handshake with scheduler so carving ties to slots is safe.
Kevin: Short-term option: mark 'sprint-ml' noisy and move them to a tiny dedicated carveout, or evict to preemptible slice until they shape. Cheaper to isolate but operational overhead.
Maria: Eviction costs credits and disrupts customers. Alternative: steer their egress via the egress-proxy and enforce token-bucket limits per-tenant (transparent, less invasive).
SRE-Bot: Incident created INC-2026-0412-117. Notifying @oncall-sre.
Devon: @oncall-sre can you triage? I can push the egress-proxy canary to rack-7 and apply 50mbps tenant cap.
Aj: If you run a canary, keep window short (5-15m) and collect NIC HW counters + nvlink stats: `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=utilization.gpu,utilization.memory --format=csv` and `ethtool -S eth0`.
Maria: Proposed plan:
1) tag tenant as noisy in tenant-dir so routing can honor it
2) deploy egress-proxy canary for 'sprint-ml' on rack-7 with 50Mbps rate-limit
3) monitor 15m for P95/tx-drops/nvlink bursts
4) if stable, promote; if not, execute dedicated carveout/eviction runbook.
I'll open a quick PR for the runbook and metrics dashboard.
Kevin: :thumbsup: I'll prepare a dedicated carveout in case the canary regresses. Need a fast cost estimate for 4x p4d for 24h.
Maria: Quick ballpark: 4 x p4d reserved 24h ~ $X (I’ll put exact numbers in PR).
Devon: I’ll own tracer collection + dashboard panels. Meeting in 20m to walk through dashboards and rollback knobs.
Aj: :eyes: starting canary now, pushing proxy with tenant filter ===>>> rack-7
Maria: Thanks — please paste canary link and I'll monitor.
Devon: Canary link: https://canary.redwood/internal/egress-proxy/1775. Metrics dashboard pinned to #eng-infra.
Maria: Monitoring shows P95 back down to ~120ms after 3m, tx drops decreasing. Keeping watch for 15m.
Kevin: If stable at 15m we can close INC and follow up with billing + placement recommendations.
Maria: Noted. I'll update incident and close if clean after 15m.
